exposure: use of maternity care services in Hong Kong
outcome: South Asian women's views and experiences regarding maternity care services
cohort: The study participants were 20 English-speaking South Asian women who had used maternity care services in Hong Kong within the past 5 years.
finding: Four themes were identified detailing comparisons with home country services, navigation of the Hong Kong maternal medical care system, discrepancies in optimal care perception, and the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on maternity care experiences.
mod_finding: One theme explored involved comparing maternity care services in their home country versus Hong Kong, specifically mentioning differences in mode of birth and care.
